rows.grounds: compound of ahorātra and udayaḥ in nominative singular masculine
third person singular active present of root as

items.question: What rises even in a living being?
premises: Even in a living being day-night rising exists.
The verse states an embodied daily cycle.
items.inference: The verse affirms that day and night arise even within a living being.
uncertainties: prāṇīye is read as locative of prāṇin.
ahorātrodayaḥ is treated as a compound meaning day-night rising.
items.plain_english: Even in a living being, there is the rising of day and night.
